Sets the topic to subscribe to. The topic specified can be the literal topic
name, or a regular expression that matches multiple topics.

A comma-separated list of options. To request a value for the
max_backlog, pass the value in the options as follows: max_backlog=
NN. For example, to request a max_backlog of 7, your application would
pass the following option: max_backlog=7.
